benefits.name: Annual Global Companion Award
benefits.description: 25,000-point Global Companion Award issued on the card anniversary each year, for a travel companion on the same itinerary when redeeming points.
benefits.terms: No spending requirement. Reduces the points cost of a companion ticket booked with points.

benefits.name: Spend-Based Global Companion Award
benefits.description: Additional 100,000-point Global Companion Award after spending $60,000 or more on the card in the anniversary year.
benefits.terms: Requires $60,000+ in purchases in the prior anniversary year.

benefits.name: Alaska Lounge Passes
benefits.description: 8 Alaska Lounge passes per year (2 issued per calendar quarter).

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Valid for the cardholder plus children on the same same-day flight with Alaska, Hawaiian, oneworld, or partner airlines.

benefits.terms: 2 passes issued per calendar quarter, 8 total per year.

benefits.name: Inflight Wi-Fi Passes
benefits.description: 8 Alaska inflight Wi-Fi passes per year (2 issued per calendar quarter).
benefits.terms: 2 passes issued per calendar quarter, 8 total per year.

benefits.name: TSA PreCheck / Global Entry Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a TSA PreCheck or Global Entry application fee.
benefits.terms: Up to $120 every 4 years. Allow 6-8 weeks after the application fee is charged for the credit to post.

benefits.name: Free Checked Bag
benefits.description: Free checked bag for the cardholder and up to six guests on the same reservation, flying Alaska or Hawaiian Airlines.
benefits.terms: Requires the Alaska/Hawaiian ticket to be purchased with the card. Includes preferred boarding for the same group.

benefits.name: Instant Flight Delay Credit
benefits.description: $50 instant statement/travel credit when an Alaska flight is delayed 2+ hours or canceled within 24 hours of departure.

benefits.name: Inflight Purchase Discount
benefits.description: 20% back on Alaska/Hawaiian inflight purchases (food, beverages, Wi-Fi) paid with the card.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Primary coverage for damage/theft on most rental cars.
benefits.terms: Primary coverage. Decline the rental company's collision coverage to activate.

earningRates.terms: Cardholders with an eligible Bank of America checking or savings account receive an additional 10% bonus on points earned.
